cases.script:
mkdir -p d empty
: > d/bashclaude_a.pkg; : > d/bashclaude_b.pkg; : > d/bashclaude_c.pkg; : > explicit.pkg
/usr/bin/touch -d '2025-01-01' d/bashclaude_a.pkg; /usr/bin/touch -d '2020-01-01' d/bashclaude_b.pkg; /usr/bin/touch -d '2015-01-01' d/bashclaude_c.pkg
export BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR=$PWD/d
claude update 2>"$HOME/e1"; echo "newest-rc=$?"
[[ $(<"$HOME/e1") == *"claude update: installing $PWD/d/bashclaude_a.pkg"* ]] && echo newest-by-mtime=yes || echo "newest-by-mtime=NO [$(<"$HOME/e1")]"
claude update ./explicit.pkg 2>"$HOME/e2"
[[ $(<"$HOME/e2") == *"claude update: installing ./explicit.pkg"* && $(<"$HOME/e2") != *bashclaude_* ]] && echo explicit-used=yes || echo "explicit-used=NO [$(<"$HOME/e2")]"
BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR=$PWD/empty claude update 2>"$HOME/e3"; echo "none-rc=$?"
[[ $(<"$HOME/e3") == *"no bashclaude_*.pkg found in $PWD/empty"* ]] && echo none-diagnostic=yes || echo "none-diagnostic=NO [$(<"$HOME/e3")]"
cases.oracle: claude.c bcl_cmd_update contract and help text: an explicit PKGFILE is used; otherwise the newest (ls -t, i.e. by modification time, not by name) bashclaude_*.pkg in BASHPKG_LOADABLES_DATADIR; with none a diagnostic naming the directory and status 1. Fixture directory with three empty packages whose mtimes order opposite to their names. The update runs in a child /bin/bash which in the guest is GNU bash without a pkg builtin, so the install step reports 'pkg unavailable' (status 1) after the selection line, which is what makes the selection observable here.
cases.comparison: r1: selection of the package to install: newest by mtime (bashclaude_a.pkg although bashclaude_c.pkg sorts last), the explicit PKGFILE verbatim, and the no-package diagnostic with status 1. Signature/ABI/arch/digest rejection, install-then-load sequencing and reload of the invoking shell are not exercised by this case.
